snippet.title: TERRORSTORM: Ground Zero Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
TERRORSTORM: Ground Zero is the world's first true FPS Horror Soulslike. Inspired directly by games like Resident Evil and Dark Souls, with an original and unique, full-metal soundtrack inspired by the modern Doom series.
For fans of Resident Evil, Dark Souls, Wolfenstein and Doom. 

Plot Summary: You are a lone mercenary hired to save the daughter of a local government official who has been kidnaped by a criminal organization that chemically and surgically transforms people into horrific "products" to be auctioned off on the dark web. Prepare to engage in visceral, high-stakes combat against dangerous and terrifying foes, uncover dark secrets hidden deep within, and bring down a horrific underground crime ring.

GAME FEATURES:

- FPS Soulslike combat

- Melee combat (last resort option once out of ammo, but can be used to interact with the world and gain access to otherwise locked areas and items)

- Fully interconnected world

- souls-like exploration. Most valuable items can only be found in optional areas.

- A crossover approach to storytelling, with the main plot-points expressed through character interactions and cutscenes and the details explained in item descriptions and environmental storytelling.

- Original heavy metal soundtrack
